title: Pulmonary cold sensing through Club cells triggers adipose thermogenesis to ameliorate obesity
authors: Junkun Jiang, Chengrui Liang, Zelin Wang, Zhangming Lu, Wenjing Yu, Xinran Wang, Chuan Zhang, Zhen-Ning Zhang, Bing Luan
abstract: While cold exposure is known to stimulate thermogenesis, the contribution of the lung to this process remains unclear. This study identifies a pulmonary pathway that enhances Irisin production and adipose thermogenesis, uncovering an unexpected connection between respiration and energy metabolism.
